dialogues.jp:
ぎりぎりまで粘る学生を注意しながら、暦先生
がテスト用紙を回収させる。
dialogues.en:
At the behest of the still-scribbling students,
Koyomi-sensei started gathering up the test papers.
dialogues.text:
At the behest of the still-scribbling students,
Koyomi-sensei started gathering up the test papers.

dialogues.jp:
机に突っ伏し、音夢の方を見ると、余裕そうに
友達と話をしていた。
dialogues.en:
I leaned onto my desk and looked in Nemu's direction. She
was chatting with her friends as usual."�
dialogues.text:
I leaned onto my desk and looked in Nemu's direction. She
was chatting with her friends as usual."�

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp: 「じゃあ、このままＨＲにしよっか」
最後が担任だと便利だ。
dialogues.en: That she's the final class of the day is pretty convenient.
dialogues.text: That she's the final class of the day is pretty convenient.

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp:
「って言っても、特に何にもないから終わりだ。
　早く帰って寝るなり勉強するなりするんだか
　ら、とっとと帰れよ」
dialogues.en:
"...But there's nothing to announce, so I'd end it. All of
you go home and either get a good night's rest or study some
more."
dialogues.text:
"...But there's nothing to announce, so I'd end it. All of
you go home and either get a good night's rest or study some
more."

dialogues.jp: ……おおざっぱな性格なら、なお良し。
dialogues.en:
...As casual as always in schedule, but in this occasion I'm
glad for it.
dialogues.text:
...As casual as always in schedule, but in this occasion I'm
glad for it.

dialogues.jp:
最後の授業が担任→　そのまま｛ホームルーム／ＨＲ｝→　性格が
おおざっぱ→　即終わり。
dialogues.en:
Last class of the day being with the form teacher -->
Homeroom --> Casual character --> Quick dismissal.
dialogues.text:
Last class of the day being with the form teacher -->
Homeroom --> Casual character --> Quick dismissal.
